DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ルーペを借りた方ですね。見え方はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You borrowed a magnifying glass, correct? How is the view?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ぼやけます。花の近くへ顔を寄せても、はっきり見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りたルーペがぼやけると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is blurry. Even when I move my face close to the flower, I cannot see clearly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because the borrowed magnifying glass is blurry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ルーペを目に近づけ、見る物との距離を変えてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bring the glass close to your eye and vary the distance from the object.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目の前で固定して、花から少し離すのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目とルーペを固定し花との距離を変える方法を聞き直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I hold it still in front of my eye and move a little away from the flower?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Repeat the method of keeping eye and glass fixed while changing the distance to the flower. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。今見えた所で止めてください。花は摘まず、咲いたままで見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Stop where you can see it now. You can view the flower while it is growing, without picking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 模様が見えました。この葉の細かい毛も見ていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花の模様が見え葉の毛も見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see the pattern. May I also look at the tiny hairs on this leaf?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can see the flower pattern and want to view the leaf hairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。この低い枝なら、枝を引かずにのぞけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go ahead. With this low branch, you can look without pulling it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここから見えます。花の模様と葉の毛を、ノートに描きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 枝を引かず観察しノートに描くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see from here. I will draw the flower's pattern and the leaf hairs in my notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Observe without pulling the branch and say you will draw in your notebook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 描き終わったら、ルーペは受付の箱へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you finish drawing, return the magnifying glass to the box at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つ描けました。首のひもをまとめて、ルーペを箱へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 描き終えひもをまとめてルーペを返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have drawn both. I will gather up the neck cord and return the glass to the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finish drawing, gather the cord, and return the glass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お返しいただきました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have it back. Please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅からのバスについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about buses from the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。案内に「休日は南口」とあります。今日は祝日ですが、南口へ行けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祝日の休日用南口乗り場を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The notice says “south exit on holidays.” Today is a public holiday; should I go to the south exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm the holiday boarding point at the south exit on a public holiday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、今日は南口です。平日の北口とは停留所が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, today it is the south exit. The stop differs from the weekday north-exit stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 山の交流館へ行く便も、南口からですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交流館行きの乗り場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does the bus to the mountain community center leave from the south exit too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where to board for the community center. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その便は南口の二番乗り場です。出発まであと十二分あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That bus uses stop two at the south exit. It leaves in twelve minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今から向かいます。改札を出て左が南口ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 南口への方向を確かめ移動する意思を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will head there now. The south exit is left after the ticket gate, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the direction to the south exit and say you will go there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。階段の下に二番乗り場の案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. There is a sign for stop two at the foot of the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着いたら停留所の時刻表も見ます。バスの行先表示は交流館ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停留所時刻表とバス行先表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the timetable at the stop too. Does the bus destination display say the community center?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the stop timetable and bus destination display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終点の「東谷」と出ます。交流館は途中で止まる停留所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It shows “東谷,” the terminus. The community center is a stop along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東谷行きに乗り、交流館で降ります。休日の乗り場も分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 東谷行き乗車と途中交流館下車をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the bus bound for 東谷 and get off at the community center. I understand the holiday boarding point now too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize taking the 東谷-bound bus and getting off at the intermediate community-center stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、お気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 防災用品の展示をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the emergency supplies exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家で持出し袋を作りましたが、重くて長く背負えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持出し袋が重く背負えないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I made an emergency go-bag at home, but it is too heavy to carry on my back for long.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice because your go-bag is too heavy to carry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どんな物を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you put in it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水のほか、鍋と大きな毛布を入れました。持って歩く用に考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水鍋毛布を持ち歩く想定で入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Water, a pot, and a large blanket. I was planning it for carrying while walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain packing water, a pot, and a blanket for carrying on foot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この展示では、家に置く備蓄と、すぐ持ち出す物を分けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this exhibition, we separate supplies kept at home from things to take immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: なるほど。鍋と毛布は家の備蓄へ戻し、持出し袋には薄い防寒用の物を入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍋毛布を備蓄に戻し軽い防寒品へ変更すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see. I will put the pot and blanket back in home storage and put a thin item for warmth in the go-bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to return the pot and blanket to storage and change to light cold protection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示の小さいリュックなら、重さを体験できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can try the weight of the small backpack on display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 背負ってみます。これくらいなら、両手を空けて歩けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示リュックを試し両手を空けて歩けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put it on. At this weight, I think I can walk with both hands free.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Try the display backpack and say you can walk with both hands free. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 展示品の内容表もあります。必要な薬などは、ご自分の状況に合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We also have a contents list for the display. Adapt necessary medicines and other items to your own situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表を持ち帰り、家の袋を量り直します。薬のことは、いつもの薬局でも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容表で袋を見直し薬は薬局へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the list home and weigh my bag again. I will also consult my usual pharmacy about medicines.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to review the bag using the list and consult the pharmacy about medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお持ちください。ご覧いただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take a copy. Thank you for looking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 顔色がすぐれませんが、具合はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You look pale. How are you feeling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっきから気持ちが悪いです。採血の順番を待っていますが、座っているのもつらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血待ち中の吐き気と座位のつらさを知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have been feeling nauseated. I am waiting for a blood draw, but even sitting is difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report nausea and difficulty sitting while waiting for blood collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、吐きそうですか。こちらで体を支えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you feel you are going to vomit now? I will support you here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、少し。袋をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 吐きそうな状態を伝え袋を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, a little. Could I have a bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you feel like vomiting and ask for a bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらをお使いください。いつから気持ちが悪くなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Use this. When did the nausea start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五分くらい前です。来た時は平気で、朝から何も食べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五分前発症と来院時正常及び朝食なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: About five minutes ago. I felt fine when I arrived and have not eaten anything since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain onset five minutes ago, feeling fine on arrival, and no breakfast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検査の予定を確認して、担当へ知らせます。別の場所で休めるようにしますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check your scheduled test and tell the person in charge. We will arrange somewhere else for you to rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。受付の番号が呼ばれたら、まだ来ていないと思われないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休む場所へ移る際の呼出し番号の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. If my reception number is called, will they think I have not arrived yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how your call number is handled when you move to rest elsewhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらから、ここにいらっしゃることも連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also tell them you are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。番号は三十二番です。具合が変わったらすぐお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三十二番を伝え症状変化を知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. My number is thirty-two. I will tell you immediately if my condition changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give number thirty-two and say you will report changes in symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号も伝えました。そばで様子を見ますね。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have passed on the number too. I will stay nearby and watch how you are doing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 門が壊れていたというお話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reporting damage to your gate, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。仕事から帰ると、門の右側が曲がっていました。道路に車の破片のような物もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅時の門の変形と道路の破片を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I came home from work, the right side of the gate was bent. There are also things on the road that look like car fragments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the bent gate on arriving home and fragments in the road. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今もその場所にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are they still in the same place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。踏まれないように、門の内側から写真を撮っただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現物を動かさず内側から写真撮影したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I only took photos from inside the gate so I would not step on them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you left the objects untouched and photographed them from inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に門が無事だったのは、いつでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When did you last see the gate undamaged?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝八時に出た時です。帰ったのは夕方六時でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正常の朝八時と発見の夕六時を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I left at eight this morning. I came home at six in the evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give eight a.m. as undamaged and six p.m. as discovery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車との接触を見た方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did anyone see a car hit it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣の方が昼ごろ音を聞いたそうです。車を見たかは、まだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隣人が音を聞いた情報と車目撃未確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My neighbor says they heard a noise around noon. I have not yet asked whether they saw a car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the neighbor hearing a noise from an unconfirmed car sighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのお話も含め、担当が現場の状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the scene, including that information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。曲がった門は開けにくいので、無理に直さず、家の別の入口を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 門を無理に直さず別入口を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. The bent gate is difficult to open, so I will not force it back into shape; I will use another entrance to the house.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not force the gate into shape and will use another entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた封筒についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about an envelope that was delivered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の家のポストに入っていましたが、知らない人の名前が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅ポストへ届いた別人宛て封筒を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It was in my mailbox, but it is addressed to someone I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an envelope for someone else delivered to your mailbox. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地は同じですが、部屋番号が一〇三です。私は二〇三に住んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同番地の一〇三と自室二〇三の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The street number is the same, but the room is 103. I live in 203.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between room 103 and your room 203 at the same address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒は未開封ですね。こちらでお預かりできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The envelope is unopened, correct? We can take it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、開けていません。一〇三の方に渡そうと思いましたが、留守だったので持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封と宛先部屋不在のため持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I have not opened it. I thought of giving it to the person in 103, but no one was home, so I brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is unopened and you brought it because the addressee's room was unoccupied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お届け先を確認して、配達担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the delivery address and pass it to delivery staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。私の郵便物も一緒に入っていたので、この一通だけお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分宛てと混ざった一通のみを渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. My own mail was in there too, so I am handing over only this one letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand over only the one letter mixed in with your mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの一通をお預かりしました。ほかの郵便物はお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have taken this one letter. We will give your other mail back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分宛ての二通は受け取りました。別の方の封筒をお願いできて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分宛て二通の受取を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my own two letters back. It helped to be able to leave the other person's envelope with you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm receiving the two letters addressed to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for helping. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳の記載についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about an entry in your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。引っ越しの手続きをしましたが、通帳の住所は前のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所変更後も通帳が旧住所のままと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I completed the moving procedure, but the passbook still shows my previous address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the old address remaining in the passbook after the address change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 登録が変わったか確認します。お手続きはいつされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check whether the registration changed. When did you complete the procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月の十日です。その時の受付控えも持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手続き日と受付控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the tenth of last month. I brought the receipt from that procedure too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the procedure date and show its receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認したところ、登録は新住所になっています。通帳の印字は変更前のものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I checked; your new address is registered. The printing in the passbook is from before the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。この古い印字は、新しく書き換えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録済みを理解し印字の更新を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Could you replace this old printing with the new information?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand that registration is complete and ask to update the printing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通帳の記載を更新できるか、窓口で確認します。今日お持ちの通帳が対象ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check at the counter whether the passbook entry can be updated. It is the passbook you brought today, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家で見た時に迷うので、更新できればお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手元通帳の更新希望と家で混乱する理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I get confused when I look at it at home, so I would like it updated if possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request updating this passbook and explain the confusion at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この通帳は印字を更新できます。こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can update the printing in this passbook. We will take it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。返していただいたら、新住所の番地を見て確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 更新依頼後に新住所番地を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. When you return it, I will check the street number in the new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the update and say you will verify the new address number afterwards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 更新した通帳をお返しします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the updated passbook. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお寿司を受け取りにいらした方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to collect the sushi you reserved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、井上です。四時の予約ですが、食べるのは六時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約寿司を六時に食べる予定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, Inoue. The reservation is for four, but we will eat it at six.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to eat the reserved sushi at six. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取りまでこちらで保冷できます。お帰りまで、どのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can keep it chilled here until pickup. How long does it take you to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩いて十分です。まだほかの買物があるので、先に済ませてから受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 徒歩十分と他の買物後に受け取りたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ten minutes on foot. I still have other shopping, so I would like to finish that before collecting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say home is ten minutes on foot and ask to collect after the other shopping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、最後にこのカウンターへお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then come back to this counter at the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。予約の三パックは、この大きさですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約の三パックのサイズを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. The three packs I reserved are this size, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the size of the three reserved packs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、三パックでご用意しています。お持ちの袋へは平らに入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we have three packs ready. Will they fit flat in your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 底の広い保冷バッグを持ってきました。重ねず入れられそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 底広の保冷バッグへ平らに入れる準備を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought a cooler bag with a broad base. I think they will fit without stacking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the broad-bottom cooler bag for keeping the packs flat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、受取り時にお包みします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we will pack them when you collect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に日用品を買ってから戻ります。帰ったら冷蔵し、表示の期限も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日用品購入後に戻り帰宅後冷蔵と表示確認をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will buy daily necessities first and return. At home I will refrigerate them and check the expiry shown on the label too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return after buying necessities, then refrigerate and check the label at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お戻りをお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will wait for your return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 芝生のロープについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the rope around the lawn?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもとボールで遊ぶつもりでしたが、今日は入れないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ロープのある芝生でボール遊びができるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I planned to play ball with my child. Can we not enter today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether ball play is possible on the roped-off lawn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 雨で地面が傷みやすくなっているので、今日は閉めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The rain has made the ground vulnerable to damage, so it is closed today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 投げる遊びができる別の場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の投げ遊び場所を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is there another place where we can play throwing games?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Look for another place to play catch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 遊具の奥の砂地は使えます。硬いボールではなく、柔らかい物をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may use the sandy area behind the playground equipment. Please use a soft ball, not a hard one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このスポンジのボールです。二人で近くから投げ合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柔らかいスポンジ球と近距離の遊び方を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This sponge ball. The two of us will throw it to each other from close by.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the soft sponge ball and explain playing at short distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでしたら、通路から離れた中央側で遊んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case, play toward the center, away from the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路へ飛ばない向きに立ちます。砂地へは右の道で行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路へ飛ばない向きと砂地経路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will stand facing so it does not fly toward the path. Can we reach the sand by the path on the right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm a direction avoiding the path and the route to the sand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、右の道です。水たまりをよけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the right-hand path. Please avoid the puddles as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は砂地で遊び、芝生は乾いた日にまた来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は砂地を選び芝生利用を後日へ変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We will play on the sand today and come back for the lawn on a dry day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the sand today and defer use of the lawn to another day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28222-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、楽しくお過ごしください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車券がぬれてしまったのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did your train ticket get wet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。傘を畳む時に落としました。改札機に入れていいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨でぬれた券を改札機に入れられるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I dropped it while folding my umbrella. I do not know whether I can put it in the ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a rain-soaked ticket can go into the ticket gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで拝見します。券の行先と日付は読めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see it here. I can read the destination and date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の東町行きです。切符を新しく買う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の行先を伝え買い直しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is for 東町 today. Do I need to buy another ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give today's destination and ask whether a replacement purchase is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の状態を確認できましたので、この有人通路からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have checked its condition, so we will guide you through this staffed passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。帰りの切符は別の袋に入れてあり、ぬれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰り券は別袋で無事と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. My return ticket was in another pouch and did not get wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the return ticket is safe in a separate pouch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、ぬれた券はこちらで確認の処理をします。お持ち帰りの際は別にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will process the wet ticket's check here. Keep it separate when taking it with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この小さい袋に一枚だけ入れます。列車に乗ってから提示を求められたら、そのまま見せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ぬれた券を分け車内提示時の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put just this ticket in this small pouch. If asked to show it on the train, should I present it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the wet ticket and ask how to show it on board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。まず券をお見せになって、ぬれた経緯もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Show the ticket first and explain how it got wet too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。東町行きの券を受け取り、有人通路から入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済み券を受け取り有人通路へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will take back the 東町 ticket and enter through the staffed passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the checked ticket and go to the staffed passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらへどうぞ。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: This way, please. Have a good journey.
